description: Divisional Secretariat - Kesbewa - (Section 07) Land Acquisition Rescind the errata of the Notice under Section 07 of the Land Acquisition, Published Gazette Extra No 1860/17 Dated 30.04.2014
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act.
